description:

Este(a) profissional será responsável por garantir que as iniciativas gerem valor real para o negócio, conduzindo o backlog com clareza, priorização estratégica e alinhamento contínuo com as diretrizes da empresa.

  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)

title: Executivo De Vendas Externas Adquirência - Mercado Pago
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executivo De Vendas Externas Adquirência - Mercado Pago em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito! Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que :

  • Vibram energia empreendedora : são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por :

  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região : percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica : realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda : acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar : participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.

Requisitos

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH "B" e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de atuação, Fortaleza - CE.

O que oferecemos

Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.

Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.

Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.

Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência.

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

How to Apply

Let us know about your experiences, education, and ambitions. Bring your knowledge, unique viewpoint, and creativity to the table.

Closir – Customer Success Associate

Closir is a UK‑based investor relations support services provider that helps blue‑chip companies achieve IR objectives through a comprehensive, web‑based platform.

Role Overview

We are looking for a customer‑centric, self‑driven individual to join our Customer Success team. You will manage relationships with IR teams at public companies from onboarding through to long‑term adoption, guiding them in integrating data, extracting insights, and embedding Closir into day‑to‑day workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with clients to understand their Investor Relations needs and drive adoption of the Closir platform
  • Act as a trusted advisor, providing strategic insights and support to senior IR teams
  • Deliver tailored onboarding, training, and consulting sessions
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to champion client feedback and influence product direction
  • Build long‑lasting relationships that foster retention, growth, and client advocacy

Qualifications

  • Background in Investor Relations (in‑house or advisory) – you understand the workflows, challenges, and priorities of IR professionals
  • Experience in consulting, customer success, or client‑facing roles where you’ve advised senior stakeholders
  • Strong communication and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to translate complex needs into actionable solutions
  • Passion for SaaS, fintech, and improving how companies engage with investors
  • Fluent in English and Spanish

Why Join Us

  • Work at the intersection of SaaS, finance, and strategy with a fast‑growing, global team
  • Shape the future of investor relations technology
  • Opportunity to take ownership and make a measurable impact with clients
  • Collaborative, ambitious, and supportive culture

This job vacancy is open for candidates based out of Latin America.

Marketing Ninjas – Client Success Manager

Marketing Ninjas is a faith‑driven, ninja‑themed marketing agency that helps restoration companies grow through referral partners and exclusive leads.

Key Responsibilities

  • Client onboarding and relationship management – guide new clients through the onboarding process
  • Ongoing support and strategy – review performance, provide insights, and optimize marketing campaigns
  • Retention and growth – identify upselling or cross‑selling opportunities
  • Issue resolution – address client concerns promptly and professionally
  • Training and education – educate clients on best practices for using the Marketing Ninjas Lead Engine and GoHighLevel
  • Performance monitoring – track client success metrics and proactively offer guidance
  • Collaboration – work closely with sales, marketing, and fulfillment teams using Slack, ClickUp, and GoHighLevel

What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years in a client success, account management, or customer service role (preferably in digital marketing, SaaS, or home services)
  • Fluent English speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Minimal accent for clear communication with U.S.‑based clients
  • Tech‑savvy – experience using GoHighLevel, Slack, ClickUp, or similar tools
  • Comfortable with marketing automation and CRM tools
  • Problem‑solving and results‑driven mindset
  • Organized and detail‑oriented, able to manage multiple clients and tasks efficiently
  • Commitment to faith, integrity, and conducting business at high ethical standards
  • Remote work flexibility – work from anywhere
  • Opportunities for growth in a fast‑paced, ninja‑themed marketing agency
  • Competitive salary with performance‑based incentives and supportive team environment

Telehealth – Customer Success / Onboarding Specialist

We are a rapidly growing telehealth and pharmacy platform dedicated to delivering accessible, personalized care. View it as a client success role focused on guiding patients through their treatment journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • Onboard clients with ideation calls to get them excited about the process
  • Ensure all clients are happy and frequently check in on them
  • Follow up with clients to ensure they are enjoying their experience
  • Manage multiple clients in a fast‑paced environment
  • Consistently meet performance metrics related to sales and marketing

Requirements

  • Experience in a client success and sales role
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, performance‑driven environment

AI‑Powered Analytics Platform – Strategic Customer Success Manager

Our client is a leading analytics platform that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications.

About the Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid‑size to large enterprise accounts, maximizing value, driving adoption of our AI‑powered platform, and fueling retention and expansion.

Responsibilities

  • Own complex accounts and build multi‑threaded relationships
  • Lead executive communication, including EBRs/QBRs and C‑level engagements
  • Own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across portfolios
  • Identify upsell/cross‑sell opportunities and mitigate risks to deliver measurable ROI
  • Manage complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions with project management skills
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering to resolve issues and influence roadmaps
  • Maintain strong interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus)
  • Drive measurable outcomes such as NRR, adoption, and expansion revenue

Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent) with proven success managing enterprise/mid‑market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred)
  • Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations and technical discussions
  • Experience collaborating with cross‑functional teams to resolve issues and influence roadmaps
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus)
  • Results‑driven with strong critical thinking and customer‑centric focus
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic remote environment
  • Business Intelligence (BI) or embedded analytics background a plus

Ramp Plan

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (company values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes)
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals)
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands‑on work
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end‑to‑end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion)
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement
  • Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals

Join Our Team

If you’re passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI‑powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

description:

Company Description

Upstream Capital is a tactical investor focused on growth‑stage technology companies, deploying both debt and equity to scale businesses. Headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil, the firm has a global reach, with a proven track record of investing over $200 million in over 25 tech companies across Latin America, the Bay Area, and other regions. With deep expertise in the tech sector, Upstream Capital operates as a comprehensive finance platform leveraging knowledge, networking, data, and AI to drive success. The company is committed to partnering with innovative businesses, finding creative solutions to complex challenges, and aligning success between investors and investees for long‑term growth.

Role Description

The role is designed for someone who is deeply curious about how companies operate, how their economics work, and what are the patterns that make some of them thrive. The Intern will be exposed to the full investment process and encouraged to think critically about markets and capital allocation.

Beyond analytical work, we value people who enjoy engaging with the broader investment landscape. The role involves listening, asking good questions, forming independent views, and contributing ideas to internal discussions. Curiosity and judgment matter as much as technical skills.

Upstream operates in a lean, high‑ownership environment. Interns are expected to take responsibility for their work, explore opportunities proactively, and learn by doing. We look for individuals who are comfortable navigating ambiguity and who see feedback and mistakes as part of the learning process.

Candidates may come from any academic background. What matters is intellectual rigor, attention to detail, and a consistent pattern of high personal standards. Prior exposure to finance, consulting, or technology is a plus, but not a prerequisite.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in financial modeling and deep understanding of finance principles
  • Ability to communicate insights effectively through reports and presentations
  • Experience in, or knowledge of, the technology sector is a plus
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is strongly preferred
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, business administration, or a related field

About Us

Formerly known as Upload Ventures Growth, Upstream has the goal of becoming a platform for lifecycle investing in growth and late‑stage technology companies. The firm builds on Upload's track record of supporting global founders and leverages its experience in venture capital, technology, and data to identify, underwrite, and scale high‑performing businesses.

Upstream operates with a lean structure and a hands‑on approach. We value analytical rigor, operational discipline, and the ability to execute with precision in fast‑paced environments.

Atualmente já conta com 43 três lojas. description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Key Account Pleno/Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Key Account Pleno/Sênior Options & Company – Salvador, Bahia, Brazil

Sobre a posição

Buscamos um profissional com profunda capacidade de construção e gestão de relacionamentos de alto valor, visão estratégica de longo prazo e histórico comprovado na expansão sustentável de carteiras complexas. O Key Account Pleno / Sênior será o guardião das contas mais relevantes da organização – responsável não apenas por preservar a receita existente, mas por identificar, estruturar e capturar sistematicamente novas oportunidades dentro do ecossistema de cada cliente.

Mais do que um gestor de relacionamento, este profissional atua como parceiro estratégico do cliente: alguém capaz de compreender profundamente os desafios do negócio, antecipar necessidades, propor soluções de alto impacto e influenciar decisões em múltiplos níveis hierárquicos.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gestão e Expansão de Carteira

    Gerir com autonomia e profundidade uma carteira de contas estratégicas, desenvolvendo planos de conta individualizados com metas claras de retenção, crescimento e aprofundamento de relacionamento.

    Identificar e estruturar oportunidades de up‑sell e cross‑sell de forma proativa, com base em análise de maturidade do cliente, consumo atual e potencial de expansão.

    Monitorar indicadores de saúde das contas (health score, NPS, churn risk, expansão de receita), traduzindo dados em ações táticas e planos de mitigação.

    Conduzir revisões periódicas de negócio (QBRs e EBRs) com stakeholders estratégicos dos clientes, apresentando resultados, road‑maps de valor e iniciativas conjuntas de crescimento.

  • Relacionamento e Influência Estratégica

    Construir e aprofundar relacionamentos em múltiplos níveis hierárquicos dentro dos clientes – operacional, gerencial e executivo – criando vínculos de longo prazo baseados em confiança e entrega de valor consistente.

    Posicionar‑se como consultor de confiança do cliente, antecipando necessidades, propondo iniciativas antes que sejam demandadas e participando ativamente de discussões sobre estratégia e resultados do negócio do cliente.

    Mapear e gerenciar o ecossistema de influenciadores e decisores de cada conta, desenvolvendo estratégias de engajamento customizadas por persona.

    Atuar como defensor interno do cliente, garantindo que as demandas e expectativas das contas estratégicas sejam priorizadas adequadamente pelas áreas de produto, operações e suporte.

  • Retenção e Crescimento de Receita

    Ser o principal responsável pelo atingimento das metas de Net Revenue Retention (NRR) e Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) da carteira sob gestão.

    Desenvolver estratégias de renovação antecipada e condução de processos de renegociação complexos, equilibrando flexibilidade comercial com preservação de margem e percepção de valor.

    Elaborar propostas comerciais estratégicas e materiais de apresentação executiva, com narrativa clara orientada ao ROI e ao impacto de negócio do cliente.

    Colaborar estreitamente com os times de Customer Success, Produto e Operações para garantir que a entrega sustente a percepção de valor e reduza o risco de churn.

  • Inteligência de Mercado e Contribuição Estratégica

    Monitorar movimentos competitivos, tendências de mercado e mudanças no ambiente de negócios dos clientes estratégicos, utilizando esse conhecimento para antecipar riscos e oportunidades.

    Contribuir com insights qualificados para o desenvolvimento de novas ofertas, ajustes de posicionamento e evolução de estratégias comerciais, a partir da escuta ativa e do relacionamento próximo com as contas.

    Reportar com consistência e precisão os KPIs de carteira para as lideranças, apresentando análises aprofundadas e recomendações estratégicas fundamentadas.

    Atuar como mentor e referência para profissionais de contas em estágios anteriores de carreira, contribuindo com o desenvolvimento do time e a evolução das práticas de gestão de contas da organização.

Competências Técnicas

  • Domínio avançado de CRM e ferramentas de gestão de carteira, com capacidade para estruturar pipelines de expansão, acompanhar health scores e gerar relatórios executivos com precisão analítica.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados de conta – consumo, receita, engajamento, risco – para transformar informações em estratégias de ação e narrativas de valor junto ao cliente.
  • Proficiência na construção de planos de conta (account plans) estruturados, incluindo mapeamento de stakeholders, análise de whitespace e definição de iniciativas prioritárias de expansão.
  • Capacidade de elaborar e apresentar materiais executivos de alto nível – QBRs, EBRs, propostas de valor e business cases – com rigor metodológico e clareza de comunicação.
  • Experiência com frameworks de gestão de contas estratégicas (SPIN, Challenger, MEDDIC, Miller Heiman ou equivalentes) aplicados ao contexto de expansão e retenção.
  • Fluência em ferramentas de comunicação, videoconferência e colaboração remota para condução eficaz de interações com clientes distribuídos geograficamente.

Perfil e Requisitos

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em gestão de contas estratégicas, Customer Success sênior ou vendas consultivas B2B com carteira de clientes de alto valor.
  • Histórico comprovado de expansão de receita em carteiras complexas, com métricas documentadas de NRR, up‑sell e cross‑sell.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com habilidade de interpretar dados de negócio, construir argumentos estratégicos e sustentar recomendações com evidências.
  • Habilidade de navegação em organizações complexas, com experiência em engajamento multi‑stakeholder e influência sem autoridade formal.
  • Capacidade de liderança e mentoria para contribuir com o desenvolvimento de profissionais de contas em estágios mais iniciais de carreira.
  • Certificações em metodologias de gestão de contas, negociação estratégica ou vendas consultivas (diferencial).
  • Graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas. Pós‑graduação ou MBA é considerado diferencial.
  • Trabalho 100% Presencial.
  • Disponibilidade para viajar uma vez por semana.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Visão de longo prazo e orientação estratégica – compreende que a gestão de contas é construída em horizontes de tempo, não em transações isoladas.
  • Inteligência relacional – lê dinâmicas interpessoais com acuidade, adapta o estilo de comunicação por interlocutor e constrói confiança com consistência.
  • Mentalidade de dono – assume responsabilidade integral pelos resultados da carteira, sem esperar que o ambiente externo dite o ritmo.
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a dados – transita com naturalidade entre o relacionamento e a análise, usando ambos como instrumentos de criação de valor.
  • Proatividade estruturada – identifica oportunidades antes que se tornem óbvias e age com método, não por impulso.
  • Comunicação executiva – articula ideias complexas com clareza e precisão, tanto no nível operacional quanto no estratégico.
  • Resiliência e estabilidade emocional – mantém qualidade de presença e raciocínio em situações de pressão, renegociação e complexidade.

Benefícios & Experiência na empresa

  • Estrutura e Segurança – Cartão Flash flexível (alimentação / refeição / mobilidade), Plano de Saúde completo, Seguro de Vida, Café da manhã diário no escritório.
  • Alta Performance & Saúde Integral – Programa Alta Performance e Vitalidade com treinamento físico, acompanhamento nutricional e acesso ao TotalPass (academias e bem‑estar).
  • Consultas médicas.
  • Cultura e Ambiente – orientação à alta performance com responsabilidade, proximidade com tomada de decisão, ambiente meritocrático, troca constante com profissionais de alto nível.

Job Description

The Domain Architect – Networking will play an essential role in the design, governance and evolution of the network architectures that support the digital, industrial and corporate operations of Brasil and Canada. He will be responsible for the strategic planning, specification, integration and optimization of corporate communication platforms: SD-WAN, LAN/WAN, OT/IT industrial networks, Wi‑Fi, underground networks, data centers, cloud integration, 5G, satellite and edge for mining.

Its mission is to ensure robustness, availability, performance, security, and scalability – enabling automation, digitalization, advanced analytics, industrial IoT, and support for key critical environments. He will work directly with global IT, Operations, Security, and Engineering teams, supporting a multicultural and multifunctional environment.

Main Responsibilities

Lead the design, documentation and evolution of enterprise, industrial and mission‑critical network architectures for global, underground, remote, mobile/IoT and cloud/hybrid operations.

Specify patterns, high and low complexity diagrams (logical view, physical, topology, VLAN, routing, SDN), considering redundancy, availability, performance, and resiliency.

Evaluate, select and supervise deployment of emerging technologies: SD‑WAN, SDN, Zero Trust, private 5G, mesh networks, VPNs, segmentation of OT/IT networks in a mining environment.

Define and ensure compliance with global security standards (ISO 27001, NIST, LGPD, PIPEDA), encryption policies, access control, vulnerability mitigation, and incident response.

Lead network integration projects between Brazil, Canada, industrial areas/mines, offices, plants and data centers, enabling high connectivity, performance and security.

Orchestrate processes of technological update, equipment replacement, configuration automation and network monitoring, including SRE, observability, Service Mesh.

Create and maintain detailed documentation: diagrams, flows, contingency plans, playbooks, usage policies, governance, and technical templates.

Direct interface with Engineering, Operations, Security, DevOps, Industrial Automation teams, global architecture teams and strategic suppliers.

Monitor, optimize and evolve the communication infrastructure, aiming at maximum efficiency, IoT support, industrial analytics, autonomous mine operation and compliance.

Support the development of strategic projects (mining 4.0, edge computing, digital twins, cloud/industrial integration, ESG) and train internal teams.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or related.

title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Evaluation Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.

The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.

What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes ("does this surface the right principal investigator?") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands‑on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in‑house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don’t trust or read the results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi‑step, tool‑using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research‑adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non‑engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.

Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real‑world, high‑stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.

This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

description:

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.

The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.

What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes ("does this surface the right principal investigator?") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands‑on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in‑house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don’t trust or read the results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi‑step, tool‑using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research‑adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non‑engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.

Confira esta oportunidade para Recepcionista Hospitalar | HGCCamaçari - BATemporary em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description

Faça parte da 1ª PPP em Diagnóstico por Imagem da Bahia!

Essa é a sua chance de crescer em uma empresa que transforma a saúde pública com propósito e cuidado de verdade.

Na RBD Imagem , há 10 anos dedicamos nossa energia a levar diagnósticos rápidos e precisos para milhares de pacientes do SUS. Estamos presentes em 13 unidades hospitalares espalhadas pela Bahia — de Salvador a Guanambi — fazendo a diferença todos os dias.

Aqui, valorizamos o talento, o compromisso e o olhar humano. Acreditamos que cada colaborador é peça fundamental para entregar um atendimento que vai além do exame: um atendimento que acolhe, respeita e cuida.

Se você quer fazer parte de um time que une tecnologia de ponta com o calor do cuidado humano, aqui é o seu lugar.

Responsibilities and assignments

  • Fazer atendimento ao público em unidade hospitalar;
  • Cadastrar exames radiológicos em sistema informatizado;
  • Entregar resultados de exames;
  • Organizar arquivos administrativos diversos;
  • Auxiliar na gestão do estoque;

Requirements And Qualifications

Consideramos como obrigatório:

  • Conhecimentos básicos no Pacote Office;
  • Experiência anterior com atendimento ao público;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em plantões diaristas ou 12x36;
  • Capacidade de se comunicar.

O que você precisa saber para se dar bem nesse processo?

  • Você deve reconhecer a importância de trabalhar com propósito, afinal, estamos envolvidos na missão de salvar vidas;
  • É fundamental que você apresente suas experiências e expectativas de forma clara;
  • Priorize a honestidade, sinceridade e espontaneidade, não buscamos a perfeição;
  • Antes de uma possível entrevista, esteja bem preparado, faça uma pesquisa sobre a RBD Imagem.

Benefícios Para Cuidar De Você

  • Vale Transporte e Alimentação;
  • TotalPass para incentivar seu bem-estar;
  • Plano de Saúde SulAmérica 100% custeado pela empresa;
  • Plano Odontológico MetLife com mensalidade básica paga pela empresa;
  • Seguro de Vida MetLife integralmente custeado;
  • Convênio com o SESC.

Process stages

  • Step 1: Registration1Registration
  • Step 2: Apresente para nós2Apresente para nós
  • Step 3: Entrevista com o RH3Entrevista com o RH
  • Step 4: Entrevista com o Gestor4Entrevista com o Gestor
  • Step 5: Hiring5Hiring

Vem transformar a saúde com a gente!

Onde propósito e cuidado andam juntos

Se você é apaixonado por cuidar de pessoas e acredita no poder do que faz, seu lugar pode ser com a gente. Na Rede Brasileira de Diagnóstico, você encontra um ambiente de desenvolvimento, inovação e oportunidade real de crescimento.

Nossa jornada já é trilhada por mais de 600 colaboradores, que atuam em 13 unidades hospitalares espalhadas por toda a Bahia. Com tecnologia de ponta e compromisso com a vida, já realizamos mais de 3,5 milhões de exames para pacientes do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS).

Venha fazer parte de uma equipe que acredita no acolhimento, na força do coletivo e na excelência. Juntos, vamos seguir cuidando de pessoas e transformando o presente e o futuro da saúde pública no Bahia.

Sólida trajetória em sistemas bancários de missão crítica, com foco em Cobrança e liquidação financeira.

Superior Completo em TI.

  • Experiência prévia em projetos de migração ou atualização tecnológica;

  • Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional products/services and expanding client accounts.

  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and optimization within key accounts.
  • Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments.
  • Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management.
  • Stay up‑to‑date on gambling regulations, compliance standards, and responsible gaming practices to ensure adherence and mitigate risks.

The ideal profile

We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:

  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions.
  • Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast‑paced environments.
  • Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth.
  • Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management.
  • Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners.
  • Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem‑solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data‑driven mindset for decision‑making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
  • Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.

Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.

Next steps in the process

  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!

What’s in it for you

  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full‑time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results, not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get‑togethers to connect, work, and have fun. We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.

Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE O BANCO DE TALENTOS

A Gurilândia e Land School são escolas Inspired no Brasil. O amor e o acolhimento são marcas da escola, semeadas pela Tia Vera desde a sua fundação e a Gurilândia e a Land School se baseiam em quatro pilares - Tradição, Inovação, Excelência Acadêmica e Mentalidade Internacional. Há 60 anos estamos educando gerações em Salvador, e preparando os nossos alunos para os desafios de hoje com uma educação que alia vanguarda e tradição.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de agentes de transformação que sejam capazes de alcançar realização pessoal e profissional com ética e responsabilidade social. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos, que superam desafios diariamente com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo. Se você se identifica com essa missão e quer fazer parte do time, não deixe de se candidatar!

Como nosso Professor(a) de Inglês, você cumpriria as seguintes atividades:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas como Professor(a) de Inglês alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

Para se inscrever você irá precisar ter:

  • Diploma de Licenciatura em Pedagogia;

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;
  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

A Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

The ideal candidate is content-obsessed with a strong brand lens, someone who takes one idea and immediately sees multiple formats, narratives and distribution paths. Beyond producing content, you'll ensure that everything Downtown puts out communicates the brand clearly and consistently.

You'll work closely with leadership, transforming technical knowledge into high-quality content, while reviewing and strengthening how the brand shows up across every touchpoint.

Aqui, autonomia, responsabilidade e protagonismo são nossa vivência diária. Não buscamos pessoas prontas; não saber tudo faz parte do processo. O que valorizamos é a curiosidade investigativa e o desejo genuíno de aprender.

Sua missão é liderar a transição tecnológica da nossa inteligência:

O Agora (Execução e Precisão)

  • Refinar e otimizar modelos em produção (AWS Bedrock), elevando constantemente os níveis de acurácia e performance.

O Futuro (Escala e Arquitetura)

  • Evoluir nossa infraestrutura para um ecossistema robusto de RAGs e bancos vetoriais .
  • Migrar de uma solução centralizada para uma malha de modelos especializados por contexto e seguradora.

Ensino Médio Completo

Must Haves

  • Recent, hands‑on production experience with .NET 8 or 9 within the last two years;

  • Python (FastAPI) production experience;

  • Experience with hexagonal architecture, TDD, and clean code instincts;
  • Experience integrating with payer or Medicaid systems;
  • Experience with feature flag systems such as LaunchDarkly or PostHog;
  • SOC 2 or StateRAMP experience;
  • Experience working in a PE‑backed scale‑up environment with steering‑group cadence.

Perks and Benefits

Campaign Operations Manager - Pottermore (Limited Contract)

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About this role

Based in Berlin, Audible is looking for a Campaign Operations Manager (7-month limited contract) who will serve as the planning and operational backbone for large-scale content marketing campaigns of Pottermore productions in the German market. This role will ensure flawless execution across all marketing channels through meticulous coordination, project and process management, and stakeholder communication. They will manage the day-to-day operations of complex 360-degree marketing campaigns, serving as the central coordinator between channel teams, creative teams, agency partners, and external IP stakeholders. Their mission is to ensure all campaign elements are delivered on time, on brief, and on brand through exceptional project management and attention to detail.

They will work closely with Creative, PR, Acquisition, Content Performance, Lifecycle, and Content teams, serving as the operational hub that keeps all workstreams moving efficiently and ensures nothing falls through the cracks.

Responsibilities

  • Communicate and coordinate various marketing channels including media, lifecycle, acquisition, social media at a global and local level to ensure an integrated marketing approach to the customer.
  • Create and own approval process within Audible and with external partners for all marketing channels managing revision cycles and ensuring brand compliance on both sides.
  • Facilitate discussions, remove roadblocks actively between internal teams and partner brand teams.
  • Manage vetting processes for talent, influencers, experiential elements with external partners, coordinating review cycles and communicating effectively to key stakeholders within Audible.
  • Own all legal and finance operations for large scale content campaigns, actively tracking spends, contracts and coordinating with key stakeholders within Audible and with external partners.
  • Set up and manage regular meetings and information flow with external partners and internal leaders to discuss campaign progress, track approvals, and resolve issues.
  • Own all campaign measurement by being a champion of data and help set up campaign goals based on past experiences; help set up measurement templates and own campaign measurement and reporting.
  • Identify process improvements and implement efficiencies to reduce operational friction in real time. Serve as the go-to problem solver for operational challenges that arise during campaign execution.
  • Own all media coordination and ensure timely fulfilment of assets per pre-agreed plans. Own the media planning to execution cycle across all marketing channels end-to-end.
  • Set up and maintain live project documentation, ensuring all teams have access to current information.

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers' daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications

  • Business fluency in English alongside fluent language skills in German.
  • Experience in deep marketing operations or project management.
  • Experience managing multiple complex, multi-workstream campaigns with numerous stakeholders.
  • Experience in managing budgets and contracts.
  • Experience in managing creative production workflows and approval processes.
  • Experience with project management tools and systems like Airtable and Sprinklr.
  • Experience working with external agencies and partner organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the digital entertainment, media, or content industry.
  • Language skills in French, Italian, Spanish preferred.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to coordinate across different teams, C-levels, and external organizations.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving blockers.

title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Evaluation Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About FirstIgnite FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack. We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production. The Role We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse. This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company. What You'll Do Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents. Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\ "does this surface the rightprincipal investigator?\ ") into precise, measurable rubrics. Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests. Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch. Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality. Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion. Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests. Requirements 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling. Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them. Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked. Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week. Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results. Preferred Qualifications Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents. Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems. Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain. Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs. Why This Role You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (Ci & Pm)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (Ci & Pm) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Company Description Dingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities. Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey. Role Description As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime. In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results. With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence. Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality. Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life. Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics. Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities. Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality. Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records. Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes. Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences. Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management. Qualifications Experience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments;
OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable. Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes. Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies. Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions. Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders. Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

title: Ai Performance Creative Designer (Streetwear/Exotic Cars)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Performance Creative Designer (Streetwear/Exotic Cars) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

So... what the hell is Ark Exotic? Ark Exotic is where founders and creatives who've already made it come to gather and access our fleet.Our members have driven everything. The novelty is gone. What they're chasing now is the social moments that they can't find anywhere else. We want to build a world of underground luxury that feel like scenes from a film.Now we're building a creative team to match and we need an AI-native performance designer who can sell the feeling of being inside Ark.What You'll Do Design performance creatives that feel like film stills, not ads Generate scroll-stopping visuals that pull our target deeper into the world (and the funnel) Build on-image copy that speaks to a young successful founders Maintain a visual language across motorsport, lifestyle, clothing, and brand storytelling pillars Move fast — produce cinematic visuals at the volume performance marketing demandsWho You Are We don't care about your years of experience. We care about your eye and what you've built. You've built performance ads for premium DTC, lifestyle, or fashion brands before You've mastered Freepik Spaces, Higgsfield, Runway, Midjourney, and OpenAI's Image 2 You understand the difference between\ "looks expensive\" and \"feels exclusive\ " Your portfolio looks like an A24 mood board, not a Canva carousel You've created something of your own — a brand, a zine, a film, a photo series, a fit page that proves you don't need a brief to build a world You follow filmmakers, fashion houses, and underground car culture in equal measure Streetwear, automotive, fashion, or film background? You're already shortlisted. You can tell me without thinking why the Gentle Monster\ "Hunt\" campaign works, or why a single shot of a wet parking lot at night can carry an entire brandWhat We're Building The most-watched private world in luxury automotive. Members don't join for the cars. They join for the access, the people, and the feeling of being on the inside of something most people will never see. This role defines what that world looks like to anyone discovering us for the first time. Your work will be the first impression for people who've never been impressed.What We're Offering Competitive salary based on your portfolio 10 days PTO per year Path to grow into creative lead / brand director as we scale Fully remoteHow to Apply A portfolio showing off your streetwear / midnight club design language A short paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of an Ark Exotic ad campaignIf the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Welcome to Ark.

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor De Busca)

Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas. Requisitos necessários Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados. Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância. Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual). Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank. Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados. Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem. Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto. Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps. Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua. Diferenciais Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes. Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery. Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca. Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling. Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI. Perfil esperado Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário. Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto. Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta. Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados. Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares. #SeleçãoSBF #VempraSBF

title: Amad Serviços Médicos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Amad Serviços Médicos em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. * OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\ " Junte-se à Nossa Equipede Saúde Digital! A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. * SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. * O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;
PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais. Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. REQUISITOS Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA). Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificado de Títulode Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);
ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;
Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);
Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;
Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais. Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: REMOTO Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo. I MPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Ai Agent Manager (Media)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Agent Manager (Media) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections. Job Purpose The AI Agent Manager serves as the key technical and strategic resource for the company’s AI applications, with a focus on designing, building, operating, and managing complex AI agents. This role translates high-level business requirements into functional AI agent architectures, manages the full agent lifecycle (including advanced prompting, tooling, maintenance, and performance optimization), and ensures robust, measurable business outcomes. The Manager owns the agent-building roadmap, advanced prompt engineering, agent configuration and deployment, performance monitoring, and cross-functional coordination to drive successful AI adoption across the organization. Duties and Responsibilities Main Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and agents using low-code/no-code and prompt-based platforms (e.G., multi-step prompt systems, agent frameworks). Translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions, especially for internal process automation (e.G., media planning, operations, finance workflows). Configure and optimize multi-step AI prompts (“blueprints”) to automate complex tasks across different tools and systems. Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases and define solution logic. Act as a bridge between business teams and technical infrastructure, ensuring solutions are usable by non-technical users. Test, iterate, and improve AI agents to ensure reliability, accuracy, and performance in real-world use cases. Identify opportunities for automation across departments and proactively propose AI-driven improvements. Document workflows, prompt logic, and system configurations for internal reuse and scalability. Stay up to date with advancements in AI tools, LLM capabilities, and no-code/low-code ecosystems. Core Requirements 4–7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, System Analyst, or similar role. Strong ability to translate business processes into structured workflows and logic. Hands-on experience with low-code/no-code tools (e.G., Zapier, Make, Airtable, Retool, or similar platforms). Experience working with AI tools (LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI automation platforms). Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and own end-to-end solution delivery. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher) Technical / AI-Related Experience designing multi-step prompts or AI workflows (not just single prompts). Understanding of how LLMs work and how to structure prompts for reliable outputs. Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and automation tools is a plus. Basic programming knowledge is helpful but not required. Soft Skills Strong communication skills and ability to work with non-technical stakeholders. Business-oriented mindset with a focus on practical outcomes. Curiosity and willingness to experiment with new AI tools and approaches. Ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-evolving environment. Domain Experience Experience in digital media, advertising tech, or media planning. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Proven ability to design, build, and operate sophisticated AI agents. Expertise in advanced prompt engineering, including multi-step prompting, few-shot learning, and optimizing for specific model outputs. Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT. Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative. Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles. Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements. We offer We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule). Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Fully remote. As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.
